# FRQNCY

> FRQNCY is a topic graph for consciousness — a curated public library of 146 topics covering how money, energy, mind, and matter actually work, supported by 766+ vetted resources across books, people, organizations, podcasts, places, and courses. Five pillars: Network State, Fund, Education, Research, plus an experiential pillar. The free layer is permanent; membership funds the free layer rather than gating it.

## About

- [FRQNCY](https://frqncy.network/): FRQNCY is a topic graph for consciousness — 146 maps of how money, energy, mind, and matter actually work. A reading list with conviction. A network becoming a civilisation. A fund underneath.
- [Vision](https://frqncy.network/about): FRQNCY is a living library for the conscious age — a cooperative curation network pointing seekers to the wisdom, teachers, and practices that align with their journey, across 15 domains of human experience.
- [The FRQNCY Podcast](https://frqncy.network/podcast): The mothership voice of FRQNCY. Long-form conversations with the teachers, builders, researchers, and healers already doing the work. First of the .frqncy channels — crypto.frqncy and publicspeaking.frqncy lead the way.
- [Start here](https://frqncy.network/start-here): New to FRQNCY? Start here. A guided introduction to the network, the pillars, and where to begin your exploration.
- [Sanctuary network](https://frqncy.network/space): A minimal, intentionally designed coworking and relaxation space. The first physical node of the Sanctuary. Membership-based, launching soon.
- [Chart calculator](https://frqncy.network/chart): Your chart, read back to you. Human Design, Gene Keys, natal — the on-ramp into Education. One click from where you stand.
- [Search FRQNCY](https://frqncy.network/search): Ask the network anything. 15 domains, hundreds of topics, thousands of resources — one search field, one step in.
- [Membership](https://frqncy.network/membership/): Support the network. Get nothing the public site doesn't have. The reading stays free.
- [Aligned Goods](https://frqncy.network/aligned/): A curated index of products, places, texts, and tools that help you live in alignment. Information in abundance. No paid placement.
